description.p: Aureus is a GTK4 and libadwaita portfolio tracker with activity-based holdings, account cash, dividends, portfolio history, stock search, a watchlist, reports, backups, and an adaptive interface.

Refines pull-to-refresh and Allocation rendering, redesigns Dividends with a current-year Annual view and ownership-aware history, removes the detached dollar-stem artifact from the dividend headline, gives populated Recent Distributions a reliable Adwaita boxed-list surface, aligns Edit Account with Aureus's shared bottom-pill form actions, allows accounts with holdings or activity to be removed after an explicit destructive-data warning, uses gain/loss colors for Watchlist sparklines, and simplifies Allocation center text to the selected stock and percentage, vertically centers the unselected Portfolio label, and leaves the holdings list unchanged.
Fixes same-day 1D portfolio return calculations and adds Bank of Canada attribution for exchange-rate data.
Initial Aureus 1.0 release with portfolio tracking, account cash and transfers, dividends, interactive history charts, reporting, backups, and adaptive GTK4/libadwaita navigation.
